ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to enforce sequential OCV event versions.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, Force_Update__c = false, OR( ISNULL(PRIORVALUE(OCV_Event_Version__c)), OCV_Event_Version__c - PRIORVALUE(OCV_Event_Version__c) > 1 ) )
